verdict.rationale: Resend's own docs mention a first-party automations feature for building recurring marketing flows, so the product appears to offer automated flows natively. However, the only evidence is a single thin line, with no detail on event triggers, rule definition, or available actions. Webhooks only notify external consumers of events and are a building block, not product-side rules that trigger actions. Missing for 10: documentation of event-based triggers and rule/condition definition, the catalog of actions automations can take, API or agent (MCP) access to define automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
